info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Balances-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Balances API allows users to retrieve the current loyalty points balance for members of a hotel loyalty program. This API is designed to serve hotel operators and customer service applications, providing essential data for managing customer loyalty accounts. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer engagement by readily offering information about rewards status and benefits. Typical consumers of this API include customer relationship management (CRM) systems and mobile apps that assist guests in tracking their loyalty rewards.

get.description: This operation retrieves the current points balance for the user. It allows the user to check their accumulated rewards points.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the balance of points associated with a user or account. It should contain the necessary authentication information and any relevant parameters to retrieve the balance accurately.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListHotelLoyaltyPointsBalancesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to points balance. The content type is JSON.
